_comment: Image descriptions + Meesho copy for one product. A Meesho listing needs ONLY this file.
The 66 Flipkart listing fields live separately in products/<ID>.json.
Name this file after the product ID: image-meta/ANP-1042.json
Fill it from THE PROMPT in docs/guides/START-HERE.md Part 3, then run:
npm run images -- --final        (or: npm run finish -- --in="<folder>")
title / keywords / images feed the EXIF written into each photo.
The meesho block is NOT written into any image — Meesho does not read image metadata.
It is copy you paste by hand into the Supplier Panel. Limits are in START-HERE.md.

meesho.description:
Complete 65 piece Annaprashan decoration kit in red and gold, with everything needed to set up the rice ceremony backdrop at home.

What you get:
1 Shubh Annaprashan banner
40 red and golden metallic balloons
8 red heart foil balloons
12 printed ceremony cutout props
1 LED string light
1 balloon pump with arch tape and glue dots

Perfect for:
Annaprashan, rice ceremony, first food ceremony, naming ceremony, baby milestone photoshoot

Balloons come uninflated and the pump is included, so the whole backdrop goes up in about an hour with nothing else to buy. The banner and printed cutouts are card and can be kept as a keepsake after the day.
meesho.pack_contents: 1 Shubh Annaprashan Banner - 40 Metallic Balloons - 8 Heart Foil Balloons - 12 Printed Cutouts - 1 LED String Light - 1 Balloon Pump - 1 Arch Tape - 1 Glue Dot Roll
